title: Candidate pipeline: Nuggets & Risks — Hiring + Onboarding Triage (2025-04-11)
content:
Purpose: quick weekly triage for open IC hires, incoming new joiners, and emergent team-health signals. This is a working note (short, slightly messy).

Attendees: Asha (owner), Liam (interviewer coordination), Ravi (hiring metrics), Sofia (onboarding ops), Jin (eng manager - backend/team health)

Context/goal:
- Get a snapshot of candidate funnel, immediate risks to offers/start dates, and readiness of new-hire onboarding for the April/May cohort.
- Output: 6 concrete action items owners + short timeline to mitigate biggest risks.

Candidate quick hits (active pipeline):
1) Candidate: "SWE Backend - Cand B" (onsite 04/09)
   - Interviewers: Liam, Jin, Priya (infra)
   - Notes: strong systems instincts, slower on open design prompts; flagged by Priya for limited infra/hybrid ops exposure.
   - Scorecard: 3.6/5 (consensus).
   - Risks: compensation expectations slightly above band; background check note (international verification) may add 10-12 days.
   - Next step: Recruiter to re-open comp band discussion with candidate by 04/14 (owner: Liam).

2) Candidate: "Eng Tools - Cand F" (take-home submitted 04/08)
   - Notes: crisp automation examples, great focus on DX; flagged as high fit for DX sprints.
   - Scorecard: internal green-light pending take-home review.
   - Risk: one competed offer in market; need fast loop.
   - Next step: Quick sync with hiring manager to finalize offer target; target send 04/15 (owner: Sofia + hiring manager).

3) Candidate: "ML Infra - Cand D" (loop ongoing)
   - Notes: very strong LLM infra background; discussed quantization/serving tradeoffs in depth.
   - Scorecard: 4.5/5.
   - Risk: wants remote from APAC; need to coordinate with finance/comp on locale/benefits.
   - Next step: ops to confirm payroll/benefits plan for APAC hires and present options 04/18 (owner: Ravi).

Immediate pipeline-level risks and mitigations:
- Offer latency: average time-to-offer is 18 days (target 10). Root cause: two bottlenecks — hiring manager scheduling and comp approval queue.
  - Mitigation: enforce 48-hour interviewer availability window for onsite scheduling; dedicated comp-approver rotations (tentative owner: HR lead).
- Onboarding readiness: 3 new joiners starting 05/05 (backend, infra, SRE). Current issue: infra VPC access provisioning (security) can take 7–10 business days.
  - Mitigation: pre-provision placeholder accounts with limited scopes; escalate to security for expedite. (owner: Sofia)
- Candidate ghosting on take-homes: ~12% of take-home tasks getting no response after 7 days.
  - Mitigation: template follow-up cadence + reduce take-home size to 60 minutes for select roles. (owner: Liam)

Team health signals (from 1:1s + manager sync):
- Bandwidth: multiple ICs report high context switching due to interviews + oncall; average weekly interview time increased 45% over last quarter. This correlates to delayed PR reviews on key infra tickets (GH-PR-2892 referenced).
  - Short-term: rotate interviewers more evenly across squads; cap interview load to 4 hrs/week per engineer. (owner: Jin)
- Onboarding feedback loop: recent hires reported lack of a single place for timelines (who to ping for laptop/keys/VPN). New onboarding page in Confluence exists but is not discoverable.
  - Medium-term: consolidate onboarding checklist into a one-page 'day 0 checklist' and pin in the team Slack #new-hires. (owner: Sofia)
- Morale: positive — team excited about product shipments; friction around unclear expectations for project ramp speed. Managers recommend ramp plans with explicit milestones at 2/4/8 weeks.
  - Action: create a two-week ramp template for hiring managers to fill before start date. (owner: Asha)

Onboarding checklist (current gaps called out):
- Pre-start week: laptop ordered + asset tag (ops), Okta SSO request, GitHub access (org invite), internal wiki + team Slack invites, VPC sandbox access (placeholder), onboarding buddy assigned.
- Day 0: welcome doc, intro meetings scheduled (buddy, manager, security), local dev setup doc (step-by-step), first-week goals (2 small tickets), payroll forms.
- Week 1–4: 4-week ramp with check-ins at end of week 1,2,4; pairing sessions scheduled with buddy; doc reading list.

Notes-to-self / informal observations:
- Interviewer calibration: we still have some variance in score interpretation (one interviewer uses 1–3 scale; others 1–5). Need calibration session. Short-term hack: include 2-line rationale mandatory in every scorecard. (owner: Liam)
- Recruiting partner: inbound sows from recruiter X have been better quality; consider expanding contract by +10% if no budget spike. (owner: Ravi)

Action items (concrete, with owners + ETA):
1) Send offer target note for Eng Tools candidate and aim to extend offer by 2025-04-15. Owner: Sofia. Linked: JIRA-4123.
2) Re-open comp conversation with Backend candidate and finalize within 3 business days (2025-04-14). Owner: Liam.
3) Confirm APAC payroll/benefits options for ML Infra candidate by 2025-04-18. Owner: Ravi.
4) Create 'day 0' one-page onboarding checklist + publish to Confluence and pin to #new-hires by 2025-04-20. Owner: Sofia.
5) Interviewer calibration workshop (30–45m) — schedule week of 2025-04-21; mandatory for all interviewers. Owner: Asha + Jin.
6) Temporary pre-provisioned limited VPC sandbox for incoming hires (task with infra/security) — request expedite, target 2025-04-22. Owner: Sofia + Jin. Linked: GH-PR-2892.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Weekly follow-up cadence: Tuesdays 10:00am PT (15 min) — quick triage + owners update. First follow-up: 2025-04-15 (short status notes expected in this doc).

Appendix (helpful links and quick refs):
- Hiring dashboard (internal): confluence.redwood/eng/hiring-dashboard
- Onboarding playbook: confluence.redwood/eng/onboarding-playbook
- Slack threads: #hiring-coordination, #new-hires, thread: slack.com/archives/C123/nomination-0425 (reference)
- PR blocking infra setup: GH-PR-2892

Quick retrospection after today's sync: keep this triage lean — aim for 6 items max. Capture blockers and owners inline; remove granular interview notes from this doc (move to candidate-specific scorecard links).

If you read only this line: priority = extend fast to strong candidates (reduce offer latency) + pre-provision minimal infra for early productivity.

-- Asha
